title: tvOS multi-layer parallax poster
blurb: Composite three independent drawable HTML poster layers in one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas with 3D parallax tilt, inter-layer cast drop shadows, a glossy squircle sheen and clickable tilted controls.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas tilt three separate drawable HTML poster layers in 3D with inter-layer cast shadows and a diagonal glossy sheen while keeping an editable title input and action buttons clickable?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27, 412 px, 2.625 DPR): 6/6 live checks pass, 1.09 MP and 8.68 MB on one ElementGL context, 0 CLS under 4x CPU throttle, and tilted Play trailer and Watchlist buttons hit via elementsFromPoint().
